description:
Recorded right at the official 7:05 sunrise on 4-7-23 at the Ash Cave State Park in Ohio, USA. The Cave & Waterfall are directly behind the recorder by about 100 yrds. The recorder was pointed away from the waterfall, towards the forest trying to catch the dawn chorus of birds. There is a small creek about 15 ft to the left. No human sound.

Zoom H1n recording.
name: Ash Cave Sunrise - distant Waterfall behind me - creek just to the left - woods birds to my front 4-7-23.wav
